title: LA City General Fund postings, April 2026 vs April 2025

attempts.text: The City of Los Angeles General Fund posted a decrease of 1.3% in April 2026 compared to April 2025, with a decrease of $12.8 million in its year-to-date postings through April 2026. This decline is primarily attributed to a decrease in Non-Departmental - General postings, which decreased by $27.1 million from $339.0 million in April 2025 to $339.0 million in April 2026.

final_text: General Fund postings were $937.5m in April 2026, down 1.3% from $950.3m in April 2025. Year-to-date postings were $8.08bn, up 2.0%. The largest movements were: Non-Departmental - General decreased by $27.1m; Non-Departmental - Liability Claims decreased by $12.8m; Fire increased by $11.1m.
